contracts.boundary: Prompt-free CLI over real issue bodies with a gh-backed remote probe; tests inject the probe and a temporary working root, so no network, credential or repository state is required.
contracts.assertions: Cited paths are extracted from prose without version numbers, host names or provider identifiers; a citation missing from the working tree fails; a citation present locally but absent from the selected branch is reported as local-only and fails only under --require-remote; an offline run never reports a remote verdict.

boundaryTest.name: classifies a local-only citation as unpublished and not missing

invariant.name: fails a citation that is missing from the working tree

fault.name: fails a local-only citation only when remote publication is required

contracts.boundary: Developer and CI entry point for the reference check; the alias owns no behavior beyond invoking the checked script.
contracts.assertions: The check:issue-refs alias resolves to scripts/check-issue-refs.mjs and package.json stays valid JSON.

boundaryTest.exception: A script alias has no boundary of its own; the script and its tests are declared by issue-refs-check.

invariant.exception: No state or invariant is owned by a package.json script alias.

fault.exception: Injecting a fault into an alias would duplicate issue-refs-check's tests without adding a distinct assertion.

contracts.boundary: Documentation only. Every command it records was executed against this repository before it was written down.
contracts.assertions: The document names the authoritative read paths, native blocking edges, sub-issue attachment, staged bulk edits and the citation rule.

boundaryTest.exception: Documentation-only file; there is no executable boundary to exercise.

invariant.exception: Documentation-only file; it owns no state or invariant.

fault.exception: Documentation-only file; there is no implementation to fault-inject.
